Note: Bringing in JD Vance at the end doesn’t really work. This administration’s track record has a way of getting around (the world). 

 Orban, Beacon to the Right, Concedes Defeat in Hungary’s Election nytimes.com/2026/04/12/world… via @NYTimes

One of many reasons I strongly opposed the “Big Beautiful” Betrayal of a bill. First tariffs. Then this.

Rural Minnesota economies under threat as feds cut safety net programs startribune.com/federal-bene…

Big congratulations to Hermantown’s Max Plante of the Minnesota Duluth Bulldogs on winning the Hobey Baker Award—the top honor in college hockey!

duluthnewstribune.com/sports…

Melissa and Mark Hortman were dedicated to serving others and were proud parents who loved their family and our state. Thank you to Sophie and Colin for sharing their story—and to all working to honor their legacy.

startribune.com/sophie-and-c…

I met with leaders from our Hmong community who play a big role in strengthening our state's entire economy—especially now. The ICE surge took a real toll on small businesses, but Minnesotans have supported each other and we are coming back strong.

Nice! And congrats to the entire crew and NASA staff.


Reid Wiseman (@astro_reid)

Mission complete ❤️❤️❤️





— https://nitter.net/astro_reid/status/2043058823091417542#m
Joined an incredible group of DFLers in Eagan today. So much energy and greatly appreciate the grass roots support for my campaign for governor. Let’s get to work!
Great to be with hundreds of energized DFLers (and some great kids) in Eden Prairie! Thanks for the spirited intro from high school teacher/legislator extraordinaire Steve Cwodzinski!
Exciting to watch the successful reentry of Artemis II. Congrats to NASA and all staff and the incredible crew members!

Our first responders put their lives on the line to keep us safe.

That’s why I fought to pass the Honoring Our Fallen Heroes Act to ensure that we support families of first responders who pass away or are permanently disabled by service-related cancers.

The President should be prioritizing what’s made right here at home.

duluthnewstribune.com/news/l…

Costs are up. Chaos is up. And corruption is up. 

This Administration is not focused on bringing down prices. Instead, they have dragged us into a war in the Middle East and trade wars across the globe.
I was with a great group of DFLers in Bemidji. Across Minnesota, people are organizing, talking to their neighbors, and bringing people together for a better future for all of us.

Incredible bravery and calm under pressure shown by St. Paul Fire Captain Brian Buxton rescuing DNR Officer Annette Schlag. It’s a powerful reminder of the skill, training, and teamwork our first responders use to keep us safe.

Video

We broke ground on the Highway 5 Improvements Project, which will add two lanes between Victoria and Chanhassen and greatly help locals with the increasingly popular U of M Arboretum traffic. I pushed for federal funding for this project along with Rep. Emmer, former Rep. Phillips & Sen. Smith to reduce congestion, improve safety, and support one of the fastest-growing areas of our state.

Last year, we passed my major bipartisan legislation with Sen. Ted Cruz to take on the brutal sharing of nonconsensual sexual images, real or deepfake. Tragically, a number of kids committed suicide over the sharing of these. 

Good news: The first conviction under this law was just secured of an Ohio man who victimized multiple people with his creation of pornographic deepfakes online.

One good story to start the day…

Dog roaming highway rescued after construction crew feeds her, builds her a hut washingtonpost.com/lifestyle…

In Eden Prairie with Rep. Morrison and local leaders to tour the new Mobile Command Center. I worked with Sen. Smith & former Rep. Phillips to secure federal funding for this critical project that will improve real-time coordination in emergencies and help first responders keep people safe.

A touching tribute to an incredible mom and late wife of NASA Commander Wiseman.

The astronauts on Artemis II honor Carroll Wiseman, who passed away from cancer, by naming a lunar crater after her.


CBS News (@CBSNews)

In an emotional moment broadcast live from the Orion spacecraft, the Artemis II crew chose to name a Moon crater “Carroll" after commander Reid Wiseman's wife, who died of cancer in 2020.

“It's a bright spot on the Moon. And we would like to call it Carroll."

Video
